title: Linked cancellation
prompt: Implement `static async Task<int> RaceTask(Task<int> a, Task<int> b, CancellationToken external)` returning whichever of a/b finishes first — and it must stop waiting when external cancels, throwing OperationCanceledException. Use CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource and Task.WhenAny with cancellation registration.

tests.name: race-external-cancel
tests.hint: Link the token; register a callback that completes a TaskCompletionSource, WhenAny over both tasks plus that TCS task.

tests.name: race-fast-wins
tests.hint: WhenAny returns the first completed; return its result.
